content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The record states only that the Agency 'concluded that Complainant failed to prove that he was subjected to discrimination as alleged,' with no evidence, findings, or reasoning connecting the accepted claims (a), (b), and (k)-(q) to that conclusion."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Claims (k)-(q) are attributed to Complainant's account, and there are ROI page cites (246-7, 49-51), but 'the witness' is unidentified, claims (a)-(j) are not described, and no SHSS or management response is sourced."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Claims (k)-(q) carry dates from April 15 to August 10, 2018, listed in reverse order, but claims (a)-(j) are undated in the excerpt and key procedural dates (EEO counseling, formal complaint, ROI, hearing withdrawal, final decision, appeal) are absent."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record notes a final decision under 29 C.F.R. § 1614.110(b) after the hearing request was withdrawn, but identifies no deciding official, no legal standard or threshold applied, and no consideration of management explanations or Complainant's rebuttal."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"The excerpt begins mid-narrative, omits claims (a)-(j) and any analysis, and cuts off mid-citation, so an independent reviewer could not assess from the record alone whether the no-discrimination conclusion is supported."}}}
